{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes — apply a lag correction: if last 5 days show upward momentum, reduce forecast peak by 5-10%.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 30-day average, reduce by 2-5% per day until convergence.",
    "For sentiment = 0.00, use a 3-day moving average of true outcomes to dampen volatility and avoid overfitting.",
    "When sentiment > 0.00, allow slight upward bias (≤ 3%) to capture bullish momentum, but cap at 10% above 30-day mean.",
    "If forecast is consistently below true outcome over 5 consecutive days, increase forecast by 2-3% per day to catch up.",
    "For high volatility (> 5% daily range), reduce forecast variance by 15-20% to avoid over-optimism.",
    "If sentiment is positive and price is rising, apply a 1-day lag correction: forecast = previous day’s true outcome + 0.5x (current day’s true outcome - previous day’s true outcome)."
  ]
}
